test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 16 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following programmes is implemented by NABARD?

options.text: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
Umbrella Programme for Natural Resource Management

solution:
The correct answer is __**Umbrella Programme for Natural Resource Management**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Umbrella Programme for Natural Resource Management (UPNRM)** is implemented by the National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD).
 
• UPNRM aims to provide financial support for projects related to natural resource management, with a focus on sustainable and inclusive growth.
 
• The programme encourages community-based approaches to managing natural resources, promoting the livelihood of rural communities.
 
• It emphasizes the sustainable use of land, water, and other natural resources to enhance productivity and ensure environmental sustainability.
 
• The initiative also seeks to integrate various stakeholders, including local communities, government agencies, and non-governmental organizations, in the planning and execution of resource management projects.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **NABARD** (National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development) was established in 1982 to promote sustainable and equitable agriculture and rural development through effective credit support, related services, institution building, and other innovative initiatives.
 
• NABARD plays a pivotal role in the development of the rural sector in India by providing financial and technical assistance for various development projects.
 
• In addition to UPNRM, NABARD also implements several other schemes and programmes aimed at enhancing agricultural productivity, rural infrastructure, and the overall quality of life in rural areas.
 
• NABARD's initiatives are aligned with the broader goals of the Government of India to achieve rural prosperity and sustainable development.
